## c1
skills: AWS, Cloud architecture

**Assertion:** Certified as an AWS Solutions Architect at associate level.

**Evidence:** Took it to settle an argument about whether the ingest pipeline should
run on managed services or on the boxes we already had. The exam's storage and
networking sections were the half that mattered; the pipeline moved to managed
services three weeks later and the on-call load halved.
